Se actualizó la ficha de “{name}” en el Hub de agentes
findings.problem: The dialog's three receipt titles are split across two constructions: the two first-publication titles are bare past-participle headlines ('Publicado …'), the update receipt is a full preterite passive-reflexive sentence ('Se actualizó la ficha …'). Each is grammatical and none is misleading, but the family is uneven inside one dialog, and the locale's shipped sentence receipts for this exact event are the 'Se + pretérito' form (ui.hub.links.published 'Se publicó {item} en {source}', ui.hub.links.updated 'Se actualizó {item} desde {source}', ui.notices.agents.saved 'Se guardó {name}.'). Not a MAJOR: no meaning, polarity or feature difference, and no register break - bare participles are shipped es too, but as status labels ('Creado', 'Archivo guardado'), not as sentence receipts.
findings.proposed_fix: Harmonise on the shipped sentence receipt: 'Se publicó “{name}” en {destination}' and 'Se publicó “{name}” en el Hub de agentes' (+3.0 px at the sample name); keep 'Se actualizó la ficha de “{name}” en el Hub de agentes' unchanged. The alternative direction (participle everywhere) would need a participial construction for the update receipt that reads worse in Spanish ('Ficha de “{name}” actualizada en el Hub de agentes').
findings.evidence: Measured at 16px with the sample name 'Revisor de código': 'Publicado “{name}” en el Hub de agentes' is 336.0 px and 'Se publicó “{name}” en el Hub de agentes' is 339.0 px (+3.0 px). The update receipt on the same sample is 419.0 px against ~464 px of dialog header content, so the harmonised form stays on one line.

findings.problem: The visible Get label is 42.0px at 12px against 18.0px for 'Get'. In the card footer at the 280px minimum grid column (256px of footer content, px-3), with 3-digit like/favourite/download counters the row measures 248.0px in es against 224.0px in en - 8px of slack where the source leaves 32px. With 4-digit counters both languages wrap (en 263.0px, es 287.0px), so the wrap threshold is not introduced by Spanish, the margin is: the label leaves one counter digit of headroom. Nothing is clipped - the button is whitespace-nowrap/shrink-0 and the footer's documented fallback is a second line - so this is a fit-margin risk, not truncation.
findings.proposed_fix: Keep 'Obtener': it is the shortest natural Spanish Get (42.0px; 'Descargar' is 53.0px and 'Instalar' changes the meaning; the imperative 'Obtén' breaks the guide's infinitive action rule). Verify the footer line at the 280px minimum column with 3-digit counters in QA; if it wraps there, the fix is layout (footer gap/px), not copy.
findings.evidence: width_measurements: rows for counter_sample 128 (fits, 8px slack) and 1,840 (wraps in both).

Every pre-existing key in those seven files was proved byte-equal to parent 73af0b6855; only the 25 added keys are judged.

2. Mechanical: key set and order identical to en in all seven files, per-key placeholder multiset identical, no empty value, JSON parses, no ICU structure in these 25 (none carry plural/select, checked both ways), locale typography (U+201C/U+201D/U+2026/U+00BF, no ASCII quotes, no three periods), pre-existing keys byte-equal to the parent commit.
3. Accuracy: element-by-element reading of each value against the English source and its context sidecar (role, tone, length_hint, note, placeholder semantics).
4. Idiom and register: tú throughout, infinitive action labels vs imperative headings/invitations, sentence case, neutral Spanish, no Title Case, no '!'.

5. Terminology: compared against shipped es siblings for agent/agente, team/equipo, Agent Hub/Hub de agentes, listing/ficha, configuration run/ejecución de configuración, Delegates, Get, retry/retrying, Show all/Show less, and the shared age phrases.

6. Fit: advance widths measured with HarfBuzz (hb-shape) in the app's real type sizes and fonts (SF Pro at text-meta 12px / text-heading 16px, Geist Mono at text-mono-sm 11px) against the containers read from the components: 288px roster button, 256px card footer content at the 280px minimum grid column, ~464px dialog title content, 304px narrowest docked composer.

rulings.verdict: MINOR finding ES-AL-1, not a gate
rulings.reasoning: Both constructions are grammatical es and neither confuses update with first publication; the update receipt says UPDATE exactly as the sidecar demands. The locale ships both forms, but the shipped SENTENCE receipts are 'Se + pretérito'; giving the participle pair the shipped form makes the dialog uniform for one extra word each.

The fact must be a one-word noun: the note forbids a verb ('Delega' would be the imperative the note rules out), and the shipped sibling states the same capability as 'Puede delegar en subagentes' (ui.agents.detail.delegate.label/aria). 'Delegación' is the one-word noun of the same root, 10 code points against the ~9-character slot, and reads as a capability tag between the source label and 'Specialist' (AgentMeta joins facts with ' · '). No contradiction with the switch's sentence, and no second name for the concept.

rulings.verdict: accepted with the measured fit note, MINOR ES-AL-2
rulings.reasoning: EN's visible label is deliberately shorter than its aria 'Download {name}', and es 'Obtener' mirrors that choice, is shipped es for Get (ui.onboarding 'Obtener {name}', ui.common.account 'Obtener más créditos') and is 11px shorter than 'Descargar' in the tightest footer slot. Accepted as the term; the measured margin is recorded for QA.

rulings.item: 'Hub de agentes' and 'ficha' in the upload titles
rulings.reasoning: 'Hub de agentes' is the shipped navigation render (ui.hub.pages.header.title, ui.shell.sidebar_navigation.agent_hub, ui.command_palette.use_palette_sources.agent_hub) and matches the sidecar's instruction to follow the hub page title. 'ficha' is the shipped word for a hub listing (ui.agents.upload.action.open_listing 'Abrir la ficha', ui.agents.publication.action.update_listing 'Actualizar la ficha existente'), distinct from 'conjunto de instrucciones' for the content.

Shipped twice in es (ui.agents.navigation.updates.action.retrying, ui.hub.teams.public.trying) and it is the gerund of the shipped 'Reintentar'. It also renders narrower than the idle label of the same button (73.0px vs 'Volver a intentar' 79.0px at 12px), so the in-flight state cannot overflow where the idle state fits. 'Trying…' is softer in English, but the press being acknowledged IS a retry here, so the meaning is exact.

Identical to the shipped product term (ui.agents.config.status.attached 'Ya había una ejecución de configuración en marcha', ui.agents.detail.alert.conflict_body), so the two explanatory paragraphs introduce no second name, as the sidecar requires.

The guide allows lowercase fragments; the es age messages render 'hace 4 días', so the composed line reads 'author · actualizado hace 4 días' with no doubled 'hace'. 'actualizado' matches shipped es (ui.code_review.age.* 'actualizado hace …', ui.chat.pickers.info_model.up_to_date). Gender agrees with the subject: an agent (masc.) on a card and an equipo (masc.) in a team row; the created arm stays distinguishable ('creado').

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Measure the es/en strings under audit against their real containers.

Font: the app's declared sans stack resolves to the macOS system UI face on this
platform (`--font-sans: system-ui, ...`), rendered here with HarfBuzz through
hb-shape at /System/Library/Fonts/SFNS.ttf; counters use the bundled
GeistMonoNerdFontMono-Regular.otf at text-mono-sm. Type sizes and paddings are
read from the repo's own classes (text-meta 0.75rem, text-heading 1rem, button
size sm h-7/gap-1/px-2/[&_svg]:size-3.5, footer px-3, card p-4, grid
minmax(17.5rem,1fr)). Output is one JSON document; nothing is asserted by hand.
"""
import json
import subprocess

SANS = "/System/Library/Fonts/SFNS.ttf"
MONO = "src/renderer/src/assets/fonts/GeistMonoNerdFontMono-Regular.otf"


def width(text, size, font=SANS):
	proc = subprocess.run(
		[
			"hb-shape",
			f"--font-size={size}",
			"--no-glyph-names",
			"--output-format=json",
			font,
			text,
		],
		capture_output=True,
		text=True,
		check=True,
	)
	return sum(glyph["ax"] for glyph in json.loads(proc.stdout))


def button_sm(text, size=12, font=SANS, border=0):
	# h-7 gap-1 px-2, [&_svg]:size-3.5
	return border + 8 + 14 + 4 + width(text, size, font) + 8


out = {
	"method": {
		"shaper": "hb-shape (HarfBuzz)",
		"sans": SANS,
		"mono": MONO,
		"type_sizes": {"text-meta": 12, "text-mono-sm": 11, "text-heading": 16},
		"containers": {
			"card_min_column_px": 280,
			"card_footer_content_px": 256,
			"card_provenance_content_px": 248,
			"dialog_lg_content_px": 464,
			"docked_composer_content_px": 304,
			"roster_column_px": 288,
		},
	},
	"labels": {
		"Get": width("Get", 12),
		"Obtener": width("Obtener", 12),
		"Descargar": width("Descargar", 12),
		"Instalar": width("Instalar", 12),
		"Obten_imperative": width("Obtén", 12),
		"Show all": width("Show all", 12),
		"Mostrar todo": width("Mostrar todo", 12),
		"Show less": width("Show less", 12),
		"Mostrar menos": width("Mostrar menos", 12),
		"Add agent manually": width("Add agent manually", 12),
		"Añadir agente a mano": width("Añadir agente a mano", 12),
		"Add team manually": width("Add team manually", 12),
		"Añadir equipo a mano": width("Añadir equipo a mano", 12),
		"updated": width("updated", 12),
		"actualizado": width("actualizado", 12),
		"created": width("created", 12),
		"creado": width("creado", 12),
		"Trying…": width("Trying…", 12),
		"Try again": width("Try again", 12),
		"Volver a intentar": width("Volver a intentar", 12),
		"Reintentando…": width("Reintentando…", 12),
		"Describe what you want…": width("Describe what you want…", 12),
		"Describe lo que quieres…": width("Describe lo que quieres…", 12),
		"Ask for a change, or describe something new…": width(
			"Ask for a change, or describe something new…", 12
		),
		"Pide un cambio o describe algo nuevo…": width(
			"Pide un cambio o describe algo nuevo…", 12
		),
	},
	"card_footer_row": [],
	"provenance_line": [],
	"dialog_titles": [],
	"placeholder_about": [],
	"other_slots": [],
}

for count in ("128", "1,840"):
	count_px = width(count, 11, MONO)
	like = 8 + 14 + 4 + max(16, count_px) + 8
	downloads = 4 + 14 + 4 + max(24, count_px) + 4
	group = like + 2 + like + downloads
	for lang, label in (("en", "Get"), ("es", "Obtener")):
		row = group + 8 + button_sm(label, border=2)
		out["card_footer_row"].append(
			{
				"counter_sample": count,
				"locale": lang,
				"row_px": round(row, 1),
				"available_px": 256,
				"slack_px": round(256 - row, 1),
			}
		)

for author in ("Radient Labs", "Equipo de plataforma"):
	author_px = width(author, 12)
	for lang, phrase in (("en", "updated 4 days ago"), ("es", "actualizado hace 4 días")):
		out["provenance_line"].append(
			{
				"author_sample": author,
				"locale": lang,
				"line_px": round(author_px + width(" · ", 12) + width(phrase, 12), 1),
				"available_px": 248,
			}
		)

for name in (
	"Revisor de código",
	"release-crew",
	"Агент проверки",
	"代码审查助手",
	"Asistente de revisión de contratos y políticas internas",
):
	for lang, template in (
		("en", 'Updated the Agent Hub listing for “{n}”'),
		("es", 'Se actualizó la ficha de “{n}” en el Hub de agentes'),
		("es", 'Se publicó “{n}” en el Hub de agentes'),
	):
		out["dialog_titles"].append(
			{
				"name_sample": name,
				"locale": lang,
				"template": template,
				"width_px": round(width(template.replace("{n}", name), 16), 1),
				"available_px": 464,
			}
		)

for name in ("Revisor de código", "Агент проверки", "代码审查助手", "release-crew"):
	out["placeholder_about"].append(
		{
			"name_sample": name,
			"value": f"Cambia {name}…",
			"width_px": round(width(f"Cambia {name}…", 12), 1),
			"narrowest_docked_content_px": 304,
		}
	)

out["other_slots"] = [
	{
		"slot": "ui.agents.pages.add_manual.* : full-width ghost button in the 288px roster column",
		"locale": "es",
		"text_px": round(width("Añadir equipo a mano", 12), 1),
		"icon_px": 16,
		"padding_px": 16,
		"required_px": round(width("Añadir equipo a mano", 12) + 16 + 16, 1),
		"available_px": 288,
		"note": "20-glyph label + 16px icon + the button's own padding, well inside the column",
	},
	{
		"slot": "ui.common.actions.retrying : ghost sm retry button in a wrap-enabled status row",
		"locale": "es",
		"idle_button_px": round(button_sm("Volver a intentar"), 1),
		"busy_button_px": round(button_sm("Reintentando…"), 1),
		"note": "the in-flight label is narrower than the idle one, so the state change cannot overflow the row",
	},
	{
		"slot": "ui.agents.detail.read.show_all/show_less link button (intrinsic width)",
		"locale": "es",
		"show_all_px": round(width("Mostrar todo", 12), 1),
		"show_less_px": round(width("Mostrar menos", 12), 1),
		"note": "link buttons are intrinsic-width inside a prose column; the 48px figure in the sidecar is the measured English link box, not a cap",
	},
]

print(json.dumps(out, ensure_ascii=False, indent=1))

                          "--output-format=json", SANS, s], capture_output=True, text=True, check=True)
    return round(sum(g["ax"] for g in json.loads(out.stdout)), 1)
name = "Revisor de código"
variants = {
    "participle_published_public": f"Publicado “{name}” en el Hub de agentes",
    "preterite_published_public": f"Se publicó “{name}” en el Hub de agentes",
    "preterite_republished": f"Se actualizó la ficha de “{name}” en el Hub de agentes",
}
result = {k: {"text": v, "width_px": w(v)} for k, v in variants.items()}
result["delta_preterite_minus_participle_px"] = round(
    result["preterite_published_public"]["width_px"] - result["participle_published_public"]["width_px"], 1)
result["dialog_header_content_px"] = 464
print(json.dumps(result, ensure_ascii=False, indent=1))
